changeRecord.title: load applied in the wrong direction
changeRecord.target: load 2 of case D (memberDistributed on S1): direction Y -> Z
changeRecord.whyItMatters: The same magnitude along another axis is a different load case: gravity applied horizontally becomes a sway load, a load along the member axis produces axial force instead of bending, and a load out of the plane of a plane frame goes straight into the out-of-plane restraints or bends the members about their weak axis. With Y-up and Z-up conventions both in use this is an easy slip.
changeRecord.precondition: a nodal load or member load
